en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a grand three‑storey villa with ornate gables and a balcony. The building is labeled on its façade as "König Friedrich August" and is surrounded by trees, a garden with tables and chairs, a wrought‑iron fence, and a streetlamp in front. Printed text at the top right reads "Kurheim 'König Friedrich-August' Bad Elster." The image has the look of an early‑20th‑century spa or guesthouse in a wooded resort town.
